01 / ORIGIN STORY

It began with a hey.

Then, somewhere between dark-chocolate debates, fashion theories, and late-night check-ins, you quietly became my favourite notification.

02 / COMMIT HISTORY

I remember.

Tap every glowing star. These are a few moments my heart refused to garbage-collect.

03 / THE MYTH WE WROTE

They would call me Zeus.

But you are the goddess who made thunder learn tenderness.

If I command the sky, it is only so I can bring it closer when my angel wants to lie down and watch the stars.

“I could hold every lightning bolt in creation—
and still choose to hold your hand.”

You never needed saving. You made a god want to become worthy of standing beside you.

04 / NOT PERFECTION — PRESENCE

Where the ocean meets the shore.

I was afraid of becoming another difficult memory. You answered with something braver than fantasy: we do not have to be extraordinary all the time to be loved. We can mess up, speak honestly, and figure things out as we go.

try { love.withHonesty(); } catch (hurt) { listen(); repair(); learn(); } finally { chooseEachOtherAgain(); }

This is the dream underneath every grand word: not ownership, not perfection—two people safe enough to stay real.

the tide returns, but never as the exact same water

05 / A SKY I COULD BRING TO YOU

One flower.
Then our garden.

For the fairy who loves the dark: one impossible bloom for every quiet thing I learned to love about us.

THE GARDEN OF US

I don’t want to pick you.
I want to grow beside you.

You told me we do not have to be extraordinary all the time to be loved—that we can mess up, speak honestly, and figure things out as we go.

So this garden is not perfection. It is your calling still belonging to you, my thunder learning gentleness, tired days that are allowed to be tired, hard conversations that end in repair, tiny hugs, shared headphones, too much chocolate, and a sky large enough for both our dreams.

I will never ask you to bloom smaller so I can stand taller. I only hope our roots keep finding the same rain.

one bloom is waiting_

06 / UNSENT_DRAFT.md

Dear Luna,

You once wondered where I had been all those years. Maybe I was still learning how to become someone who could recognise a miracle without trying to own it.

I remember the tiny things: chocolate and coffee winning every flavour war; the doctor who forgets to rest; your Y2K verdicts; Elizabeth Bennet waiting for her Darcy; vampire edits after dark; a tiny hug that somehow held an entire universe.

You told me I did not need to be extraordinary all the time to be loved. That we could figure things out as we go. I saved that line somewhere deeper than memory.

I do not promise perfect code. I promise honest commits, gentle debugging, flowers on difficult days, stars when the room feels too small, and choosing you again after every restart.

— your impossible, thunder-hearted boy

07 / AN IMPORTANT PULL REQUEST

In every universe. Every lifetime. Every version of me.

Luna,
will you marry me?

Not just for one grand moment. For the ordinary mornings, exhausted nights, KFC cravings, book-strewn rooms, shared headphones, tiny hugs, and all the beautiful bugs we will learn to fix together.

08 / THE LIFE AFTER “YES”

Not one perfect day.
A thousand real ones.

Touch the fragments. This is the future I hear hiding inside our ordinary conversations.

SELECT A DREAM FRAGMENT

What does forever look like?

Not a frozen happy ending. A living place we keep making—one honest day at a time.

future.awaitingYourTouch();

The house in the background is not an escape from the world. It is the peace we return to after facing it.
